```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to sync (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag:
        required: true
        type: string
      perform_release:
        required: true
        type: boolean

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    if: ${{ inputs.perform_release == true || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine version components
        id: version
        run: |
          TAG="${{ inputs.tag }}"
          # Remove leading 'v' if present
          CLEAN_TAG="${TAG#v}"
          MAJOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_TAG" | cut -d. -f1)
          MINOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_TAG" | cut -d. -f2)
          PATCH=$(echo "$CLEAN_TAG" | cut -d. -f3)
          
          echo "major=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "minor=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "branch_name=docs/v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "variant_name=V${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.branch_name }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          # Check if branch exists
          if git ls-remote --heads origin "$BRANCH_NAME" | grep -q "$BRANCH_NAME"; then
            echo "Branch $BRANCH_NAME exists. Updating..."
            git checkout "$BRANCH_NAME"
            git reset --hard "$TAG"
          else
            echo "Branch $BRANCH_NAME does not exist. Creating..."
            git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME" "$TAG"
          fi
          
          # Force push to ensure sync
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

      - name: Create Gitbook Variant (if x.y.0 release)
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
          VARIANT_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.variant_name }}
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.branch_name }}
        run: |
          echo "Creating Gitbook variant: $VARIANT_NAME for branch: $BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Check if variant already exists to avoid duplicates
          EXISTING_VARIANT=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/$GITBOOK_SPACE_ID/variants" | \
            jq -r ".data[] | select(.name == \"$VARIANT_NAME\") | .id")
          
          if [ -n "$EXISTING_VARIANT" ] && [ "$EXISTING_VARIANT" != "null" ]; then
            echo "Variant $VARIANT_NAME already exists. Updating branch reference..."
            curl -s -X PATCH \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"branch\": \"$BRANCH_NAME\"}" \
              "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/$GITBOOK_SPACE_ID/variants/$EXISTING_VARIANT"
          else
            echo "Creating new variant $VARIANT_NAME..."
            curl -s -X POST \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"name\": \"$VARIANT_NAME\", \"branch\": \"$BRANCH_NAME\"}" \
              "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/$GITBOOK_SPACE_ID/variants"
          fi
```
